resolution.note: lane run uses sandbox settings, scrubbed env and a pre-minted App token

title: krn lane run delivers inside the harness sandbox with only the App token
body:
Outcome: `krn lane run --task <id>` starts its headless session with the sandbox settings of C1 (`.claude/settings.sandbox.json`) instead of `--permission-mode bypassPermissions`, the GitHub App token minted by the launcher before start, and no operator GH_TOKEN or keyring in its environment; one real small ready task is delivered end to end through the verb.
Why: S1 (PR 573) starts sessions with bypassPermissions and its ship was stubbed in tests; S7 runs 20 real tasks through this verb.
Proof: a test sees the sandbox settings and the scrubbed environment in the spawned argv/env; a verbatim capture of the real run's verdict line and the PR author `app/krn-works-delivery` under `.krn/runs/lane-run-e2e/`.
Scope: `src/cli/lane-run.ts`, `test/cli/lane-run.test.ts`, the launcher token helper if needed.
Program: .krn/runs/krn-program-v2/06-program.md section 2, follow-up of slice S1.
